title: See what a full order costs on each world
blurb: Buying 99 of a crafting material? Set a quantity at the top of any item page and Ultros works out the cheapest listings that fill it on every world: the total, the average per unit, how many retainers you'll visit, and how short a world falls if it can't cover the order. When splitting the order across worlds saves gil, that shows up first. It follows the HQ/NQ filter on the listings table.
